submitted.rationale: Of the three merit measurements, index 22 (Cu0.128 Fe0.114 V0.759) gave the highest photocurrent, 3.6e-7 A. The mid-composition point had 2.6e-7 A and the most V-rich edge had 2.9e-7 A, which suggests a local optimum around V ≈ 0.75 with Cu and Fe near 0.1 each. The library is also sampled most densely in that region.
